verses.text: “<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>按<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>全<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>会<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>室<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>、<ruby>宗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>族<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zú</rt></ruby>、<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>数<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby><ruby>目<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>计<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>算<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suàn</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>男<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nán</rt></ruby><ruby>丁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dīnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fán</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>岁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suì</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby>，<ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>仗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>伦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lún</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>照<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>军<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jūn</rt></ruby><ruby>队<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>数<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>点<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diǎn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>每<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Měi</rt></ruby><ruby>支<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>派<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pài</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>本<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běn</rt></ruby><ruby>支<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>派<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pài</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>族<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zú</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>帮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>助<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>字<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>：<ruby>属<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǔ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>流<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Liú</rt></ruby><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>示<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shì</rt></ruby><ruby>丢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diū</rt></ruby><ruby>珥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>蓿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xu</rt></ruby></mark>；

<ruby>属<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǔ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>缅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miǎn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>苏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Sū</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>沙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby><ruby>代<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>示<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shì</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>蔑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby></mark>；

<ruby>属<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǔ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>犹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>米<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ná</rt></ruby><ruby>达<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ná</rt></ruby><ruby>顺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shùn</rt></ruby></mark>；

<ruby>属<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǔ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>萨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sà</rt></ruby><ruby>迦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>苏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Sū</rt></ruby><ruby>押<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yā</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ná</rt></ruby><ruby>坦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>业<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby></mark>；

<ruby>属<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǔ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>布<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>伦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lún</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>希<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>伦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lún</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>押<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yā</rt></ruby></mark>；

<mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>瑟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>孙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sūn</rt></ruby>、<ruby>属<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǔ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>莲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>米<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>忽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hū</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>沙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby><ruby>玛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎ</rt></ruby></mark>；<ruby>属<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǔ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>玛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ná</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>蓿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xu</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>迦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>玛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark>；

<ruby>属<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǔ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>悯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǐn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jī</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>尼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ní</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby></mark>；

<ruby>属<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǔ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dàn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>米<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>沙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby><ruby>代<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>希<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>谢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiè</rt></ruby></mark>；

<ruby>属<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǔ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>设<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>俄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">É</rt></ruby><ruby>兰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lán</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>帕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Pà</rt></ruby><ruby>结<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby></mark>；

<ruby>属<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǔ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>迦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>丢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Diū</rt></ruby><ruby>珥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>萨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sà</rt></ruby></mark>；

<ruby>属<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǔ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ná</rt></ruby><ruby>弗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>南<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nán</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>希<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby></mark>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>哥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Gē</rt></ruby><ruby>辖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiá</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>孙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sūn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>会<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>幕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>搬<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bān</rt></ruby><ruby>运<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yùn</rt></ruby><ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>办<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>乃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>：

<ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>营<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>伦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lún</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>摘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhāi</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>遮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhē</rt></ruby><ruby>掩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>柜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>幔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">màn</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>蒙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ménɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>盖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡài</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>柜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuì</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>狗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>皮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pí</rt></ruby><ruby>盖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡài</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>再<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>蒙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ménɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>纯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chún</rt></ruby><ruby>蓝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lán</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>毯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>杠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>穿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuān</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>院<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>四<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sì</rt></ruby><ruby>围<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>柱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>带<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>卯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>座<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby>、<ruby>橛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jué</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>、<ruby>绳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>器<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>具<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby>。<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>抬<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>器<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>具<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>按<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>指<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>定<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dìnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>米<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>孙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sūn</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>族<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zú</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>会<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>幕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>办<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>司<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>伦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lún</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>玛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎ</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby>。”

<mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>伦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lún</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>会<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>诸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhū</rt></ruby><ruby>首<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>领<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>哥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Gē</rt></ruby><ruby>辖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiá</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>孙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sūn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>照<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhào</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>室<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>、<ruby>宗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>族<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zú</rt></ruby>，

<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>伦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lún</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>点<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>灯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>台<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tái</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>灯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dēnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>灯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>照<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhào</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>吩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>咐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>灯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>台<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>做<ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>金<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīn</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>锤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuí</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>连<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby><ruby>座<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>带<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>花<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huā</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>锤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuí</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。<mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>制<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>灯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>台<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>照<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhào</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>指<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>示<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>式<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>晓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>谕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：
verses.heading: 为利未人行洁净与奉献礼

verses.text: “<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>选<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lì</rt></ruby><ruby>未<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>洁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>净<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>洁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jié</rt></ruby><ruby>净<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby>：<ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>除<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chú</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>弹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tán</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>剃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tì</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>刀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dāo</rt></ruby><ruby>刮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuā</rt></ruby><ruby>全<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>洗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>衣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>服<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>洁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>净<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rán</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>取<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>牛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niú</rt></ruby><ruby>犊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dú</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>献<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>素<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sù</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>调<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiáo</rt></ruby><ruby>油<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>细<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xì</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby>；<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>另<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>取<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>牛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niú</rt></ruby><ruby>犊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dú</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>赎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shú</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiānɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lì</rt></ruby><ruby>未<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>奉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>会<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>幕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby>，<ruby>招<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhāo</rt></ruby><ruby>聚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>全<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>会<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiānɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lì</rt></ruby><ruby>未<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>奉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby>，<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>按<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>伦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lún</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>奉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby>，<ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>摇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yáo</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>办<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bàn</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lì</rt></ruby><ruby>未<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>按<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>牛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niú</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>赎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shú</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>燔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>献<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby>，<ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lì</rt></ruby><ruby>未<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>赎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shú</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>极<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>谦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiān</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby>，<ruby>胜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>忽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hū</rt></ruby><ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>伦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lún</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>米<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>暗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>会<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>幕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>。”<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>云<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yún</rt></ruby><ruby>柱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>降<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>临<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lín</rt></ruby>，<ruby>站<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhàn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>会<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>幕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>召<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>伦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lún</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>米<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>暗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>且<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiě</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>：<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>先<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiān</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>异<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>象<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>显<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>现<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>梦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>仆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>全<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>尽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>忠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>乃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>谜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mí</rt></ruby><ruby>语<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>且<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiě</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>形<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>毁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>谤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>仆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>何<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>惧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>怕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pà</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>怒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nù</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>云<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yún</rt></ruby><ruby>彩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cɑi</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>会<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>幕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>挪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nuó</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bú</rt></ruby><ruby>料<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liào</rt></ruby>，<mark class="pn"><ruby>米<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>暗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>麻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">má</rt></ruby><ruby>风<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>雪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuě</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>白<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bái</rt></ruby>。<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>伦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lún</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>米<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>暗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>麻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">má</rt></ruby><ruby>风<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēnɡ</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>愚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>昧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mèi</rt></ruby><ruby>犯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fàn</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>加<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>母<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>腹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby>、<ruby>肉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ròu</rt></ruby><ruby>已<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>半<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bàn</rt></ruby><ruby>烂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">làn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>胎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tāi</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>哀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">āi</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>医<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>治<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>！”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>父<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>亲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīn</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>吐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>脸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>岂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？<ruby>现<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>营<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby><ruby>关<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuān</rt></ruby><ruby>锁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>七<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt verses.text: “<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>会<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>怨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>言<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>忍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rěn</rt></ruby><ruby>耐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>几<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>怨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>言<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>指<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>誓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>照<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>达<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>耳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>待<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>尸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>首<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shou</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>旷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>野<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>且<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiě</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>数<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>点<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diǎn</rt></ruby>、<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>岁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suì</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby>、<ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>怨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>言<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>誓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby>；<ruby>惟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>孚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>尼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ní</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>迦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>勒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>嫩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nèn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>书<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shū</rt></ruby><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>才<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cái</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>妇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>孩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>、<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>掳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>掠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lüè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>领<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>厌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yàn</rt></ruby><ruby>弃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>尸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>首<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shou</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>旷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>野<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>女<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǚ</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>旷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>野<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>飘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">piāo</rt></ruby><ruby>流<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby><ruby>四<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sì</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>年<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nián</rt></ruby>，<ruby>担<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dān</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>淫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yín</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>尸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>首<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shou</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>旷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>野<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>消<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>灭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>按<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Àn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>窥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuī</rt></ruby><ruby>探<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tàn</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>四<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sì</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>年<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nián</rt></ruby><ruby>顶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>担<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dān</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>孽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niè</rt></ruby><ruby>四<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sì</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>年<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nián</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>疏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shū</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>总<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>待<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>聚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>集<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>会<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>旷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>野<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>消<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>灭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>亡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby>。’”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>传<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuán</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bā</rt></ruby><ruby>兰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lán</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bā</rt></ruby><ruby>勒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bā</rt></ruby><ruby>勒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>押<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yā</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>臣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chén</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>站<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhàn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>燔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>旁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bā</rt></ruby><ruby>兰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lán</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>题<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tí</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>诗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>歌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<mark class="pn"><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bā</rt></ruby><ruby>勒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>引<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>兰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lán</rt></ruby></mark>，<mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>押<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yā</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>王<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>引<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>东<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>山<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lái</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>咒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhòu</rt></ruby><ruby>诅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǔ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby></mark>；<ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>怒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nù</rt></ruby><ruby>骂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mà</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark>。’

<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>咒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhòu</rt></ruby><ruby>诅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>焉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yān</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>咒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhòu</rt></ruby><ruby>诅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǔ</rt></ruby>？<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>怒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nù</rt></ruby><ruby>骂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mà</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>焉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yān</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>怒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nù</rt></ruby><ruby>骂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mà</rt></ruby>？

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>峰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>小<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>山<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby><ruby>望<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>；<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>独<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dú</rt></ruby><ruby>居<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jū</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>万<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wàn</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shuí</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>数<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>点<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diǎn</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>尘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chén</rt></ruby><ruby>土<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǔ</rt></ruby>？<ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shuí</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>计<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>算<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suàn</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>四<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sì</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby>？<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>终<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>终<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby>。”

<mark class="pn"><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bā</rt></ruby><ruby>勒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bā</rt></ruby><ruby>兰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lán</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>做<ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>领<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>咒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhòu</rt></ruby><ruby>诅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>仇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chóu</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>料<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>竟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>祝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>福<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby>。”

class="_idGenRuby-3">děnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>！’

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>仿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>佛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>母<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>狮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby>，<ruby>挺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>狮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby>，<ruby>未<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>曾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>野<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>食<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>未<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>曾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>喝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hē</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>伤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>者<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhě</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>血<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>决<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jué</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>躺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>卧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wò</rt></ruby>。”

<mark class="pn"><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bā</rt></ruby><ruby>勒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bā</rt></ruby><ruby>兰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lán</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>点<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>咒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhòu</rt></ruby><ruby>诅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>祝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>福<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby>。”

<mark class="pn"><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bā</rt></ruby><ruby>兰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lán</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>答<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bā</rt></ruby><ruby>勒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>岂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>‘<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>须<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xū</rt></ruby><ruby>遵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zūn</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby>’<ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？”

<mark class="pn"><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bā</rt></ruby><ruby>勒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bā</rt></ruby><ruby>兰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lán</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lái</rt></ruby><ruby>吧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>领<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>往<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>别<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bié</rt></ruby><ruby>处<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>或<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>者<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhě</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>喜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>欢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huān</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>咒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhòu</rt></ruby><ruby>诅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>。”
