verses.text: <mark class="pn"><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bā</rt></ruby><ruby>勒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>领<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐnɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bā</rt></ruby><ruby>兰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lán</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>望<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>旷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>野<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>毗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Pí</rt></ruby><ruby>珥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>山<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby><ruby>顶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bā</rt></ruby><ruby>兰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lán</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bā</rt></ruby><ruby>勒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>筑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>七<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>座<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>坛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tán</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>预<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>备<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>七<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>牛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niú</rt></ruby>，<ruby>七<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby>。”

<mark class="pn"><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bā</rt></ruby><ruby>勒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>照<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bā</rt></ruby><ruby>兰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lán</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>每<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby><ruby>座<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>坛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tán</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>献<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>牛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niú</rt></ruby>，<ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bā</rt></ruby><ruby>兰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lán</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>喜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>欢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huɑn</rt></ruby><ruby>赐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>福<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>次<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>术<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>旷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>野<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bā</rt></ruby><ruby>兰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lán</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>举<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>目<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>照<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhào</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>支<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>派<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pài</rt></ruby><ruby>居<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jū</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby>。　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>灵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">línɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>临<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lín</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>题<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tí</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>诗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>歌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<mark class="pn"><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>珥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bā</rt></ruby><ruby>兰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lán</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>，‘<ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>目<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>闭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby>（“<ruby>闭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby>”<ruby>或<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby>“<ruby>睁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby>”）<ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>言<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby><ruby>语<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>全<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>者<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhě</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>异<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>象<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>目<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>睁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>仆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：

<mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>司<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yà</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>收<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shōu</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>千<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiān</rt></ruby><ruby>夫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fū</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>夫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fū</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>金<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīn</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>带<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>会<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>幕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>纪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>念<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niàn</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>流<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Liú</rt></ruby><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>孙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sūn</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>迦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>孙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sūn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>牲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>畜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby><ruby>极<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>谢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jī</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>牧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>放<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>牲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>畜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby>，

verses.text: <ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mó</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>司<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yà</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>会<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>首<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>领<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：

“<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>录<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>底<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>本<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běn</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>谢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiè</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>宁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>希<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>本<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běn</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yà</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>示<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shì</rt></ruby><ruby>班<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bān</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>尼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ní</rt></ruby><ruby>波<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bō</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>稳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wěn</rt></ruby></mark>，

<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>会<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>攻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>取<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>牧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>放<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>牲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>畜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>仆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>牲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>畜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby>”；

<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>蒙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ménɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>恩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ēn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>业<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>领<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>旦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>河<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby></mark>。”

<mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>迦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>孙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sūn</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>流<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Liú</rt></ruby><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>孙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sūn</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>难<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nán</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>仗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>竟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>何<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>灰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huī</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>丧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>胆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎn</rt></ruby>、<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>入<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rù</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>赐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>先<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiān</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>加<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>低<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dī</rt></ruby><ruby>斯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bā</rt></ruby><ruby>尼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ní</rt></ruby><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>先<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiān</rt></ruby><ruby>祖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>窥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuī</rt></ruby><ruby>探<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tàn</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>谷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǔ</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>窥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuī</rt></ruby><ruby>探<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tàn</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>灰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huī</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>丧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>胆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>入<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rù</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>赐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>怒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nù</rt></ruby><ruby>气<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>誓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：

verses.text: <mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>遵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zūn</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>吩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>咐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>记<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>载<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>程<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>程<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>乃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>：

<ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>月<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>五<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>逾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>越<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby><ruby>节<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>次<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby>，<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>兰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lán</rt></ruby><ruby>塞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sài</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>埃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Āi</rt></ruby><ruby>及<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>昂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>惧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby>，<mark class="pn"><ruby>埃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Āi</rt></ruby><ruby>及<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>葬<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>埋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mái</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>击<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby><ruby>杀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>；<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>败<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bài</rt></ruby><ruby>坏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>兰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lán</rt></ruby><ruby>塞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sài</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>营<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>疏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shū</rt></ruby><ruby>割<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby></mark>。

<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>疏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shū</rt></ruby><ruby>割<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>营<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>旷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>野<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>倘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǎnɡ</rt></ruby></mark>。

<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>倘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǎnɡ</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>转<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>哈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hā</rt></ruby><ruby>希<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby><ruby>录<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bā</rt></ruby><ruby>力<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>洗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>密<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mì</rt></ruby><ruby>夺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duó</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>营<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yínɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>哈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hā</rt></ruby><ruby>希<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby><ruby>录<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>书<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shū</rt></ruby><ruby>珥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby><ruby>旷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>野<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>伊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yī</rt></ruby><ruby>坦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǎn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>旷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>野<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>走<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>程<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>营<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>玛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby></mark>。

<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>玛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>琳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lín</rt></ruby></mark>（<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>琳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lín</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>股<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>泉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby>，<ruby>七<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>棵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kē</rt></ruby><ruby>棕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>树<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby>），<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>营<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yínɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>琳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lín</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>营<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>红<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Cónɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>红<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>营<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>汛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xùn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>旷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>野<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>几<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>座<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>逃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">táo</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>误<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby><ruby>杀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>逃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">táo</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>逃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">táo</rt></ruby><ruby>避<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>报<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bào</rt></ruby><ruby>仇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chóu</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>误<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby><ruby>杀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>等<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">děnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>站<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhàn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>会<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>审<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shěn</rt></ruby><ruby>判<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pàn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>六<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liù</rt></ruby><ruby>座<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>逃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">táo</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>旦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>河<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>东<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>座<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>迦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>南<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nán</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>座<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>逃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">táo</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>六<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liù</rt></ruby><ruby>座<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>寄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>居<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jū</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>逃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">táo</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>误<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby><ruby>杀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>逃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">táo</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>。

“<ruby>倘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>铁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiě</rt></ruby><ruby>器<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>致<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>故<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡù</rt></ruby><ruby>杀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>；<ruby>故<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡù</rt></ruby><ruby>杀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>治<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>故<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡù</rt></ruby><ruby>杀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>；<ruby>故<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡù</rt></ruby><ruby>杀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>治<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>木<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>器<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>故<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡù</rt></ruby><ruby>杀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>；<ruby>故<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡù</rt></ruby><ruby>杀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>治<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>报<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bào</rt></ruby><ruby>血<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuè</rt></ruby><ruby>仇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chóu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>亲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīn</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>杀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>故<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡù</rt></ruby><ruby>杀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>遇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>杀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rén</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>怨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>恨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hèn</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>推<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuī</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>或<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>埋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mái</rt></ruby><ruby>伏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>往<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>扔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>致<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby>，
